mapper.select: select TAT.*, lin.state , Ta.ASSESSDATE,ts.STAFFID, ts.REALNAME,ts.USERNAME,T.ORGNAME from ( select * from TBL_ASSESS_MARK O where o.assmarkid in (select max(t.assmarkid) from TBL_ASSESS_MARK t where t.ASSID = #{assId} and t.suitable = 1 group by assorgid) ) lin inner join TBL_ASSESS_TARGET TAT on lin.ASSESSTARGETID=TAT.ASSESSTARGETID inner join TBL_ORGANIZATION T on TAT.ORGID = T.ORGID inner join TBL_ASSESS TA on TA.ASSID=TAT.ASSID inner join TBL_STAFF TS on TS.STAFFID=TA.LEADERID where ( lin.staffid = #{staffid} or TA.leaderid=#{staffid})

select TAT.*,T.ORGNAME,TS.STAFFID,TS.USERNAME,TS.REALNAME,TA.ASSESSNAME,Ta.ASSESSID from TBL_ASSESS_TARGET TAT inner join TBL_ORGANIZATION T on TAT.ORGID = T.ORGID inner join TBL_ASSESS TA on TA.ASSID=TAT.ASSID inner join TBL_STAFF TS on TS.STAFFID=TA.LEADERID where TAT.assid=#{assId}
